description: Create new guardians and add objectives. [See documentation](https://dt-url.net/site-reliability-guardian)

ComparisonOperator.description: Pass/fail direction: use ≥ when higher values are better, ≤ when lower values are better.

items.description: Use when a higher measured value indicates better performance, e.g. availability or throughput.
Use when a lower measured value indicates better performance, e.g. response time or error rate.

ObjectiveType.description: How the objective value is computed: via a DQL query or an existing SLO metric.

items.description: Run a DQL query; the first numeric result becomes the indicator value.
Use an existing SLO metric as the indicator. The metric key must start with 'func:slo.'.

EventKind.description: Controls where validation events are stored: BIZ_EVENT for Grail bizevents, SDLC_EVENT for the SDLC pipeline.

items.description: Store validation results as business events in Grail. Default for business guardians.
Store validation results as SDLC events. Intended for software delivery lifecycle pipelines.

Variable.description: Named placeholder referenced as $name in DQL queries. Default value is used unless overridden via execution context.

name.description: Alphanumeric/underscore identifier referenced in DQL queries as $name. Must be unique within the guardian.

definition.description: Default value substituted for $name in DQL queries. Can be overridden at runtime via execution context.

DisplayUnit.description: Defines unit conversion and decimal formatting applied when showing a DQL result in the UI.

base.description: Unit the DQL query returns its result in. Source unit for conversion.

display.description: Unit to display the value in after conversion. Use Default to show the base unit as-is.

decimals.description: Number of decimal places (0-4) used when formatting the displayed value.

ObjectiveLink.description: An external HTTPS URL with optional display text attached to an objective for contextual reference.

url.description: HTTPS link associated with this objective.

Objective.description: A single validation criterion evaluated each guardian run. Result is pass, warning, fail, or info depending on thresholds and the comparison operator.

name.description: Unique name within this guardian. Included in every emitted validation event as the objective identifier.

description.description: Optional short explanation of what this objective measures.

objectiveType.description: How the objective value is computed: via a DQL query or an existing SLO metric.

dqlQuery.description: DQL query to execute. The first numeric result becomes the objective value. Supports $variable interpolation.

displayUnit.description: Optional unit conversion and decimal formatting applied when displaying the DQL result in the UI.

autoAdaptiveThresholdEnabled.description: Dynamically computes thresholds from 30 days of history.

referenceSlo.description: Please enter the metric key of your desired SLO. SLO metric keys have to start with 'func:slo.'

comparisonOperator.description: Pass/fail direction: use ≥ when higher values are better, ≤ when lower values are better.

target.description: Hard pass/fail threshold. Missing this value yields FAIL. If unset with no warning, status is always INFO.

warning.description: Soft threshold. Results between warning and target yield WARNING. When set alone, yields PASS or WARNING.

segments.description: Optional Grail segments to scope the DQL query to specific data.

links.description: Fields for adding relevant links to this objective.

Segment.description: A Grail segment reference that scopes a DQL objective query to a subset of observability data.

id.description: Dynatrace Grail segment ID that scopes the DQL query to data within the segment.

variables.description: Variables to parameterize the segment filter.

SegmentVariable.description: A named variable within a segment used to parameterize the segment filter.

name.description: Name of the variable within the segment definition.

values.description: One or more values for the variable, enabling multi-value filter expansion.

name.description: Unique display name for this guardian.

description.description: Optional explanation of this guardian's purpose and scope.

tags.description: Define key/value pairs that further describe this guardian.

variables.description: Define variables for dynamically defining DQL queries

constraints.customMessage: There is another variable in this guardian with an identical name defined. Please make your variable name unique to save your changes.

objectives.description: The validation criteria evaluated each time this guardian is executed.

constraints.customMessage: There is another objective in this guardian with an identical name defined. Please make your objective name unique to save your changes.

eventKind.description: If set to null/'BIZ_EVENT' validation events stored as bizevents in Grail. If set to 'SDLC_EVENT' validation events stored as SDLC events

schemaConstraints.customMessage: There is another guardian with an identical name defined. Please make your guardian name unique to save your changes.
